died.name: Victoria
died.desc: queen regnant of the United Kingdom
died.cause: calling to her eldest son and heir, Albert, Prince of Wales

died.name: Lance Sijan
died.desc: United States Air Force fighter pilot and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: dying in Hỏa Lò Prison during the Vietnam War
died.last_words: Dad! Dad! Where are you? I need you!

died.name: Lyndon B. Johnson
died.cause: referring to his Secret Service agent. By the time Mike arrived, Johnson had already died

died.name: R. Budd Dwyer
died.cause: to the reporters who tried to stop him from shooting himself during a press conference
died.last_words: Don't, don't, don't, this will hurt someone!

born.name: Walter Raleigh
born.cause: as he lay ready to be beheaded in the Old Palace Yard at the Palace of Westminster
born.last_words: What dost thou fear? Strike, man, strike!

born.name: Francis Bacon
born.cause: John Aubrey reported in Brief Lives that the English philosopher and statesman died of pneumonia after stuffing a chicken carcass with snow to learn whether it could preserve meat.
born.last_words: Thy creatures, O Lord, have been my books, but Thy Holy Scriptures much more. I have sought Thee in the fields and gardens, but I have found Thee, O God, in Thy Sanctuary-Thy Temple.

born.name: Pierre Gassendi
born.desc: French philosopher, Catholic priest, astronomer and mathematician
born.last_words: You see what is man's life.

born.name: William Bromley Cadogan
born.last_words: I thank you for all your faithful services; God bless you.

born.name: Robert E. Howard
born.desc: American author and creator of Conan the Barbarian
born.cause: his suicide note, a quotation from "The House of Cæsar" by Viola Garvin
born.last_words: All fled, all done, so lift me on the pyre. The feast is over, and the lamps expire.
